Devouring Gel
The Slime King devours adjacent low-level slimes to restore its own health.
Tremor Stomp
The Slime King deals area-of-effect damage in a 1-ring radius.
Burrow Transfer
Every turn, the Slime King randomly teleports to a tile within a 3-tile range.
Gel Polymerization
As the Slime King's health decreases, it releases low-level slimes.
Burst Gel
The Slime Queen summons Bouncy, Flying, and Crystal Slimes within a 2- to 4-tile range.
Crystal Storm
The Slime Queen deals area-of-effect damage in a 1-ring radius.
Holy Leap
Every turn, the Slime Queen randomly teleports to a tile within a 3-tile range.
Holy Radiance
As the Slime Queen's health decreases, it gains increased attack and movement power.
Gel Guardian
The Slime God has Ebony Guardians and Blood Guardians. While the guardians are alive, it gains high defense.
Withering Gel
The Slime God charges power. Ebony Guardians can convert hostile units within a 2-tile range into slimes.
Pure Gel
The Slime God charges power. Blood Guardians can seize control of hostile units within a 3-tile range.
Arcane Resonance
After losing its Ebony Guardians and Blood Guardians, the Slime God deals true damage to enemies within a 2-tile range and summons new Ebony Guardians and Blood Guardians.
